root_cause.finding: The canonical transaction-freeze, exact-tree, ReceiptStore, idempotent persistence and crash-recovery machinery already existed. The local self-hosted post-merge completion workflow used one fixed GitHub Actions concurrency group. The RCCRI-WP8 completion run remained pending with no self-hosted job and a later main push replaced the older pending demand. The physical merge therefore became effective while the required external completion bundle remained unpersisted, causing receipt-only Git closeout work.

1070.rule: Historical recovery remains separately typed and may record ABSENT_NOT_EMITTED pre-write provenance without fabricating an original PhysicalMaterialisationTransaction identity.

1071.reason: It attempted a new RCCR v0.17 canonical programme-state generation and pointer advance for a post-materialisation fact. The immutable-history invariant requires the operational pointer to remain at already-integrated v0.16. Unique valid merge/tree evidence remains preserved.

1072.reason: Its corrected two-file append-only form preserved the v0.16 pointer/history and became the one lawful historical RCCRI-WP8 receipt reconciliation before the automatic-path remediation landed. It is preserved, not repeated. Future normal completion must use the external automatic path rather than another receipt-only PR.

normal_path: freeze exact PhysicalMaterialisationTransaction before physical write
perform already-authorised serialized physical materialisation through DSAI_VIT_PHYSICAL_CONTROLLER and existing SIQ gateway
verify physical_post_merge_tree equals qualified VIT generation tree
persist canonical four-object content-addressed completion bundle in the governed external ReceiptStore
persist append-only effective COMPLETED state outside Git
bind the programme/packet to exactly one effective completion transaction
emit at most one successor-release signal to the existing authority resolver
never infer successor execution authority and never require an ordinary closeout PR
remediation.queue_fix: Post-merge completion workflow concurrency is keyed by exact merge SHA so newer main pushes cannot cancel older pending completion demands. Each eventual invocation also drains a bounded recent first-parent window oldest-first so prior missed demands are recovered idempotently.
remediation.duplicate_policy: A second physical transaction attempting to establish effective completion for the same programme/packet fails closed with VIT_DUPLICATE_EFFECTIVE_PACKET_COMPLETION.
remediation.crash_recovery: The existing recover_effective_write_completion path remains the physical-write recovery authority. If the merge already exists and the exact qualified tree is physical, completion persistence resumes without repeating the repository mutation.
remediation.historical_boundary: A historical merge with no lawful pre-write transaction freeze is reported as historical debt and is never assigned a fabricated transaction identity. The separately governed Atlas recovery remains distinct from normal completion.
remediation.receipt_location: OVC_EXTERNAL_ARTIFACT_ROOT/receipts; repository and ephemeral fallback remain prohibited.

required_regressions: successful merge -> automatic receipt persistence -> effective COMPLETED
already-effective merge recovery does not repeat physical write
duplicate completion attempts cannot create competing effective terminal states
successor release occurs exactly once and does not infer execution authority
normal completion requires no ordinary closeout PR
historical recovery remains distinguishable from normal completion
newer main push cannot cancel an older pending completion demand
warnings: The local self-hosted Windows completion runner was unavailable/pending during diagnosis. The remediation prevents queue loss and deterministically recovers missed demands, but live external ReceiptStore debt is discharged only when that already-bound runner executes a retained completion demand.
rollback: Forward-supersede only the remediation workflow/runtime/binding records. Preserve every already-emitted ReceiptStore object, historical recovery record, PR discussion, physical Git history and substantive packet evidence. No force-push or history rewrite.
